profit.title: Revenue and occupancy by month
profit.note: Revenue is spread night by night. Expenses (Indy) and margin will come later.

bilan.title: Report {year}
bilan.docs: {n} accounting files this year | {n} accounting file this year | {n} accounting files this year
bilan.noAmount: ⚠ {n} expenses without an amount: not counted in the result (fill them in under Documents, right-click → "Type and amount…"). | ⚠ {n} expense without an amount: not counted in the result (fill it in under Documents, right-click → "Type and amount…"). | ⚠ {n} expenses without an amount: not counted in the result (fill them in under Documents, right-click → "Type and amount…").
bilan.noDate: ⚠ {n} accounting files without a date: not counted in any year (set their dates in Documents). | ⚠ {n} accounting file without a date: not counted in any year (set its date in Documents). | ⚠ {n} accounting files without a date: not counted in any year (set their dates in Documents).
bilan.unassigned: ⚠ {n} statement lines not assigned to a property: not counted here (Settings, Imports). | ⚠ {n} statement line not assigned to a property: not counted here (Settings, Imports). | ⚠ {n} statement lines not assigned to a property: not counted here (Settings, Imports).
bilan.noCharges: No expenses recorded for {year}: drop your invoices in the Documents tab and give them an accounting type (right-click → "Type and amount…").
bilan.disclaimer: The result is an estimate: revenue is the Lodgify booking amounts (before platform fees, taxes and refunds), spread over the nights of the year. Platform fees, tourist taxes and other expenses only appear if you add them in Documents. Please confirm with your accountant.
bilan.pmsDown: Loussa Bookings is not responding for this property.
bilan.pmsDisclaimer: Calculated by Loussa Bookings: Lodgify booking revenue spread over the nights of the year, expenses entered or imported (platform statements) in Loussa Bookings. Data entry is done in Loussa Bookings. Please confirm with your accountant.

livretCard.title: Guidebook and TV screen managed by Loussa Bookings
livretCard.down: Loussa Bookings is not responding for this property.
livretCard.intro: Each booking has its own guest link (Bookings tab: copy, QR code, "Send the guidebook").
livretCard.visits: {n} visits over {days} days | {n} visit over {days} days | {n} visits over {days} days

welcome.hint: Guidebook and TV screen: the reference editor is in Loussa Bookings.
welcome.title: Guidebook & TV screen
welcome.intro: Default background for the welcome guidebook and TV screen of all properties. Each property can keep it, replace it with its own background, or force no background (on its guidebook page).
welcome.statsNote: Guest guidebook opens (mobile page) per property. The TV screen is not counted: it refreshes itself every 10 minutes, which would skew the visit count.
welcome.noBg: No default background: guidebooks stay plain, unless the property has its own background.
welcome.confirmRemove: Remove the default background? Properties without their own background will go back to a plain one.

stock.hint: Place stock is managed in Loussa Places.
stock.cartPrefilled: The cart opens pre-filled: you check and place the order yourself.
stock.cartNeedAsin: Enter the Amazon reference (ASIN) of the items to restock in the catalogue.
stock.levelsNote: Levels per property and QR codes: in each property's menu (Stock, cleaning QR code).
stock.name: Name
stock.help: Each property tracks its own items: the "Tracked in" switches choose which ones (a new item is tracked everywhere by default). The quantity is the number to restock per property when the item is low or empty (e.g. a pack of 12 = 1). Tick "Subscription" if Amazon already delivers it automatically: it won't go in the cart.
stock.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}" from the catalogue (for all properties)?

files.emptyFolder: Empty folder — drag files here, or use "Add".
files.shortcuts: Double-click: open · Space: preview · Enter: rename · Delete: delete · Drag and drop: add / move
files.tagsDesc: Shared by all properties. Deleting a tag does not delete any file.
files.metaDesc: An accounting type (expense or income) makes the file count in the property report, with its date and amount.
files.noPreview: No preview for this file type.
files.metaRequired: Date and amount required for an accounting type.
files.confirmDelete: Permanently delete {what}{folders}? This action cannot be undone.
files.folderWarn: (folders: all their content will be erased)
files.moveError: An item stays in its property: moving between properties is not possible.
files.confirmTag: Delete the tag "{name}"? It will be removed from {n} item(s); no file is deleted.

imap.hint: Guest emails go through Loussa Mail via Loussa Bookings; this local mailbox is still used for management email.
imap.primaryNote: The {main} mailbox feeds attachment fetching, the Email screen and sending; Loussa Mail mailboxes are fetched by Mailer. Fetching is disabled when added.
imap.mainIntro: The app reads your mailbox {ro} (no message is marked as read, moved or deleted) and only opens emails whose sender matches a rule below. Their attachments (PDF invoices…) are filed in Documents, without duplicates.
imap.pwdHelp: Encrypted in the database, never shown again (last 4 characters only).
imap.ruleMatches: Rule "{name}": {n} email(s) over the last {days} days
imap.domainManaged: ✓ The domain {domain} is managed by {label} (mail server: {mx}) — provider selected.
imap.noDns: The server {host} does not resolve in DNS from here.
imap.domainUnknown: Domain {domain}: provider not recognised (mail server: {mx}). Pick it from the list, or "Other server".
imap.tls993: Direct TLS (port 993) — off: STARTTLS required, never a plain-text password
imap.smtpIntro: Used by the "New message" button on the Email screen. Same address and password as for reading (entered above, encrypted in the database). Each message is only sent when you click "Send", and a copy is stored in "Sent".
imap.smtpOk: ✓ Connection and sign-in successful on {host}:{port}. No message sent.
imap.uiIntro: The {link} screen shows your messages, automatically linked to bookings and contacts. Only headers and a 300-character preview are kept in the app; the body and attachments are read from your mailbox when you open a message.
imap.rulesTitle: Rules: which emails, and where to file their attachments
imap.noRules: No rules: add one below, for example for a platform's invoices.
imap.checkAddr: (check against the real address of your emails)
imap.rulesNote: Invoices from a platform account often concern all your properties: leave "To sort" and assign them later in Imports.
imap.confirmRemove: Remove the mailbox {email}? Its secrets are erased; nothing is deleted in the mailbox itself.
imap.confirmPwd: Erase the mailbox password? Reading and sending will stop.
imap.confirmCache: Clear the email cache? Your mailbox is untouched; you can sync again.
imap.confirmRule: Delete the rule "{name}"? (documents already imported are kept)

livret.title: Welcome guidebook
livret.legacy: Below: the former local guidebook of Espace Loussa (app-specific /g/ link), kept until the switchover is complete.
livret.intro: A page for the guest, no account to create, available via a link or QR code. Property information only: per-stay personalisation (door code, dates) will come later.
livret.bgNote: Background, layout and displayed widgets are set in the {tab} tab (shared by the guidebook and the TV screen).
livret.regenNote: Regenerating invalidates the old link immediately (useful if a QR code displayed somewhere needs replacing): the TV screen link changes too.
livret.rulesPh: No smoking, no parties, quiet hours…
livret.rulesIntro: Shown automatically in the property's welcome guidebook. Syncing with Lodgify is not possible (its API gives neither read nor write access to the equivalent field, {tag}): if you also want it to appear in your automated Lodgify messages, copy it by hand into Rentals > Messaging placeholders.
livret.tvIntro: Same link as the guidebook, full screen, designed to be opened on the property's TV (large text, today's guest shown if there is one). See {code} to install Fully Kiosk Browser on it. The background, layout and widgets below also apply to the mobile guidebook (Welcome guidebook tab).
livret.tvLinkNote: Paste it into the start URL of Fully Kiosk Browser on the TV. It changes if the guidebook link is regenerated (Welcome guidebook tab).
livret.tabsNote: In "Tabs" mode, the guidebook and the TV screen show a carousel with a menu bar to move between widgets.
livret.bgIntro: Shown behind the guidebook and the TV screen, with frosted-glass blocks on top.
livret.bgNone: No background, forced for this property (even if a general background exists).
livret.bgInherit: Uses the general background from the settings.
livret.bgPlain: No general background set, and nothing specific to this property: plain background.
livret.pagesNote: Each page groups one or more widgets: a carousel tab ("Tabs" mode), or a section ("Scroll" mode). A widget ticked on no page is not shown anywhere.
livret.pageBgNote: In "Tabs" mode, each page can have its own background (icon {icon}); without its own background, it keeps the property's background.
livret.setBg: Set a background for this page
livret.pageBgIntro: Replaces the property background for this page only ("Tabs" mode). Without its own background, this page keeps the property background.
livret.sWelcomeHint: Shown at the top of the page. Tip: {'{{guest}}'} is replaced by the first name of the guest currently staying.
livret.sCheckinHint: Usual time, how to get in (beyond the code, already handled elsewhere).
livret.confirmRegen: Regenerate the link? The old one (and any QR code already printed) will stop working.
livret.confirmDeletePage: Delete the page "{page}"? Its widgets will no longer be shown (reassign them elsewhere if needed).

mail.title: Email
mail.subtitle: Your mailbox, automatically linked to bookings and contacts, and sorted into folders.
mail.subject: Subject
mail.sendNote: Sent from {from} via SMTP; a copy is stored in "Sent". Attachments: 15 MB in total.
mail.filingIntro: For each inbox email matching a rule (booking → {logements}; accountant, bank, insurance, invoices → {compta}; free folders with a rule), a {copy} goes to the target folder and the {original} is moved to {treated}. An email that matches nothing stays in the inbox. Nothing is deleted.
mail.confirmText: File {n} email(s) now? A copy will go to each target folder and the original will be moved to {treated}. Missing folders will be created in your mailbox. Nothing is deleted.
mail.planTitle: Preview: {n} message(s) would be filed (out of {total} in the inbox)
mail.planMore: … and {n} more. Filing handles 50 messages per run.
mail.reading: Reading the message from the mailbox…
mail.bodyNote: Formatted, but without scripts or remote images (tracking pixels are blocked). The body is read on demand and is not stored in the app.
mail.linkPlaceholder: Link to a booking or a contact…
mail.sentNoCopy: Message sent (could not save a copy in Sent).

wizard.title: Add a mailbox
wizard.sourceQ: Where does the mailbox come from?
wizard.mailerKindQ: Which type of Loussa Mail mailbox?
wizard.unknownService: Service not recognised: pick it or choose "Other server".
wizard.mbPasswordHelp: Used for the test, then stored encrypted at the end; never shown again.
wizard.oauthIntro: Espace Loussa reads and sends with this account over secure IMAP / SMTP (XOAUTH2), without a password: only a refresh token is kept, encrypted.
wizard.oauthDesc: Fill in the OAuth application ({vars}) in {link}, return address {code}.
wizard.oauthAlt: Or pick the Loussa Mail source, which also handles the {name} connection.
wizard.sharedList: Loussa Mail shared mailboxes that {email} belongs to:
wizard.noShared: No shared mailbox: ask a Loussa Mail administrator to add you.
wizard.noPersonal: This Loussa Mail does not handle personal mailboxes yet. Meanwhile, you can add the mailbox as Local, Google or Microsoft.
wizard.personalPwd: Password (sent to Loussa Mail, which encrypts it; not kept by Host)
wizard.testIntro: Connects to the incoming server and signs in to the outgoing server. No message is read or sent.
wizard.testFail: Fix the connection (previous step) then run the test again. You can also continue and fix it later.
wizard.mailerRules: Loussa Mail mailboxes are fetched and sorted in Loussa Mail: no rules to set here.
wizard.rulesIntro: Which emails to open, and where to file their attachments ("sender → category / property" rules). Detailed rules can be edited further down the page.
wizard.recapNote: Nothing is read until fetching is enabled, and nothing is ever sent automatically: each message is sent by a click on "Send".
wizard.srcMailer: Shared team mailbox, or your personal mailbox managed by Mailer.
wizard.srcLocalHelp: Any service: server detected from the address, encrypted password.
wizard.kindPersonal: Personal mailbox (created for you in Mailer)
